analysis:
Examined all supplied units and patch orientation. DistributedInstalledPairServingGrant.swift now retains uncontradicted passing records in grants (head 464–476) and hashes their encoded JSON Lines (199–205). Artifact scoping, public grant refusal, local chip checks and divergence-based placement restrictions remain intact in the visible base/head comparison (base 565–615, 659–753; head 578–628, 682–776). No changes to encryption, cache isolation (T-041), credentials, billing or native resource admission are demonstrated here.
Public status now unions record-granted families with ClusterPublicModels declarations (head 649–673, 800–826), allowing the displayed word 'qualified' without a passing record. This is a changed evidence/trust contract relevant to T-007, T-027 and T-056, but the declaration implementation and its routing consumers are not supplied; the visible grant API still requires records, and coordinator parity approval remains a separate contract. Integration must examine ClusterPublicModels, whether declarations affect actual public admission, and whether the displayed qualification accurately distinguishes declaration from verified evidence. Also verify evidence_sha256 consumers bind the relevant artifact and policy: this digest covers passing records, not failed records or declarations. The tensor-assistant exclusion here is a display check (824); enforcement at configuration/registration needs confirmation in the related changed code, not an assumed bypass.
ClusterApprovalAttachment.swift metadata and bounded patch were examined. The excerpt indicates replacing attachment-only validation with configuration-level validation, but truncates before the executable replacement; no regression can be established. Integration must inspect head 134–139 and ClusterConfiguration.validate to confirm approval, roster, artifact and schedule checks are retained. Missing source and unchanged callers limit this local review; these material cross-file contracts require further review.
